bundle.shortDescription: Set DPI, polling rate and colour on a SteelSeries Rival 3 Gen 2
bundle.longDescription: Tune is an unofficial Linux desktop app that sets the DPI stages, polling rate and colours of a SteelSeries Rival 3 Gen 2 mouse. It is not made or endorsed by SteelSeries. The package also installs a udev rule that lets the user signed in at the computer reach the mouse's settings interface.
